items.title: Live: PM apologises for Kylie Minogue 'shag' comment
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's office has released a statement, apologising for the PM's comments about Kylie Minogue on a podcast.

items.title: FIFA throws out US striker's ban after Trump intervention
items.description: US striker Folarin Balogun is free to play Belgium despite earning a red card in his last match, in a shock decision that delights Donald Trump and "astonishes" the Belgians.

items.title: Albanese poised to sign major new treaty with Fiji
items.description: Anthony Albanese has arrived in Fiji to sign a major new treaty that will see the two countries "act together" against serious challenges.

items.title: AFP to push Australia's policing model to UN
items.description: The AFP commissioner will promote Pacific police training as a model for the United Nations when she addresses police delegates from 140 nations this week.

items.title: The 'dirty little secret' in active funds management and ETFs boom
items.description: A record number of exchange-traded funds were added to the Australian share market in the past financial year.

items.title: Live: Haaland puts Norway on the brink of famous World Cup win over Brazil
items.description: Norway looks to upset perennial challengers Brazil in New Jersey, before Mexico hosts England at the Azteca. Follow live.

items.title: What household debt levels tell us about the rise of One Nation
items.description: The paradox of a strong economy and stock market with very low consumer sentiment is not close to being resolved. Quite the opposite, the disconnect is, if anything, widening.

items.title: 'Five or six people' are running the US, as Trump reshapes the presidency
items.description: Donald Trump is undertaking regime change, not just in Venezuela, but on US soil and it is unlikely the presidency will ever be the same.

items.title: As its people dig, suspicion distracts Venezuela's government
items.description: Instead of focusing all its efforts on coordinating a widescale rescue operation, the Venezuelan government has been accused of hindering the response, and as has become apparent, our ability to cover it.

items.title: Billions in cash can't be accounted for. Where is it all going?
items.description: There is no shortage of theories, from stacks of cash hidden at home to illicit activities, but little in the way of definitive answers.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
